Textarea element produces readable output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"preprocessing\":{\"remove_forms\":false}}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<form><label>Message:</label><textarea>Default text content</textarea></form>", options);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
